digest.component_or_area: Rebar repository — cross-cutting code, architecture, documentation, and test quality
propositions: Broad shallow typing: mypy passes globally but --disallow-untyped-defs diagnostics reveal 687 errors; only rebar.graph and rebar.grounding enforce strictness; package-by-package expansion and narrowed ignore_missing_imports at transport boundaries are needed.

Complexity debt: 87 source modules exceed 500 LOC target; functions in next_batch.py:96 (compute), import_ndjson.py:118 (import_tickets), and three near-cap files combine multiple concerns; existing shrink-only ratchet prevents regression but needs continued prioritization.

Documentation/navigation drift: README and user-guide teach --assignee handling contradicting config.md spec; docs/README.md and .github/workflows route to removed config files; pyproject.toml mischaracterizes dependency topology; drift checks are absent from CI.

CI gate reliability flakiness: Python 3.11 xdist worker repeatedly dies in test_opcert_service_app.py::test_matching_guard_is_accepted with 'node down' after ~11.4k tests; identical patchset passed on rerun proving flakiness; observed across multiple Gerrit Verified and mirror runs; impacts gate reliability below external/behavioral test oracle standard.

Test-environment assumptions: test_help_overview_coverage.py:142 fails on non-UTF8 binaries under editor_assets/node_modules; test_attestation_signing.py:430 fails on shallow Git clones; both need deterministic fixture/enumeration corrections while preserving behavioral oracles.
